coverageGaps: An entry observation exists only when the original execution reaches its call; skipped calls never supply default operands.
Health data and stored HealthType are predicate-entry snapshots. The predicate return observes the actual bypass decision, not the getter's internal dispatch or its exact enum operand.

Only the first of the authenticated post-factor calls in a complete normal Process invocation preserves the factor carrier. Later entries are not independent factor witnesses; exceptional and nonlocal-resume paths are excluded.
A successful preparation or binary build is not a live capture. The first retained session must pass transport, context, invocation and exact Pack association checks.
Skill ownership, RNG, animation recovery and final server authority remain separate from these local damage operands.

evidenceBoundary.direct: Live defender/data binding at the original health predicate entry, actual normal health/UsesRaw predicate returns and the preserved original factor carrier at the first authenticated post-arithmetic call entry.
evidenceBoundary.conditional: Validated selected native build and observation backend; complete same-thread Process enclosure, exact local Pack address and observed stage associations.
evidenceBoundary.unresolved: No historical values are reconstructed by preparation; missing sites, lost rows, conflicting contexts and unbound calls remain unknown.
